# Coordinates: robot world frame at the zero pose (robot/RTC-7-layout.txt), mm.
# Welded aluminium link; machining after welding: flange faces, J2 bore and its face, holes.
# J2 axis z=142, J2 output face x=0, J2 base face (pilot 190h7) x=-95.
ASSEMBLY LINK-1
DATA material=AlMg welded concept=1

PART LINK-1-01_Weldment
MOTION fixed
DENSITY 2700
COLOR 170 180 195
# base flange on the ОПУ inner ring (D 160 <= ds 161), central hole for the J1 adapter screws
PRISM Z 0 20 RING 0 0 160 112
# deck under the J2 flange: z 10..30 (gap over the fixed outer ring), x -125..-10 (clear of link 2 at x >= 0)
PRISM Z 10 30 RECT -125 -10 -125 125
# J2 mounting plate (YZ plane) on the -X side of the J2 base face
PRISM X -115 -95 RECT -125 125 10 267
# side ribs outside the J2 flange (D 222)
PRISM Y 113 125 POLY -115 10 -115 247 -10 30 -10 10
PRISM Y -125 -113 POLY -115 10 -115 247 -10 30 -10 10
# J2 bore: pilot 190H7 (the motor and the adapter plate of J2 pass through)
CUT X -116 -94 CIRC 0 142 190
TAP X -115 -95 0 142 16 206 M8 0   # J2 flange screws from the output side
# 12 x M8 through the flange and the inner ring into the J1 adapter: D9 + head counterbore / wrench access
CUT Z -1 21 PATTERN 0 0 12 139 9 0
CUT Z 11.4 31 PATTERN 0 0 12 139 16 0
PORTP j1_ring Z 0 -1 role=on_opu_inner_ring screws=12xM8_D139 ds<=161
PORTP j2_base X -95 1 role=j2_housing fit=190H7 bolts=16xM8_D206
END

PART LINK-1-02_J1Adapter
MOTION fixed
DENSITY 2700
COLOR 120 130 150
# under the ОПУ inner ring (z -43..-28), D 155; recess on the KB32 output spigot
PRISM Z -43 -28 CIRC 0 0 155
CUT Z -44 -35 CIRC 0 0 112   # recess 112H7 x 8
CUT Z -36 -27 CIRC 0 0 50   # clears the clamp flange of the J1 input shaft
CUT Z -36 -27 PATTERN 0 0 16 100 5.5 101.2   # 16 x M5 into the KB32 output, heads on top (reached through the link-1 flange bore)
TAP Z -43 -28 0 0 12 139 M8 0   # the 12 ring screws
PORTP j1_output Z -35 -1 role=on_kb32_output fit=112H7 bolts=16xM5_D100
PORTP ring Z -28 1 role=under_opu_inner_ring
END
